chunks: And in another Hadith, raising it to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)
He said: Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) complained to his Lord, Mighty and Majestic, about back pain, so He commanded him to eat grain with meat, meaning Al-Hareys.
ai.seo_question: What was the Prophet's remedy for back pain according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) relates that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) suffered from back pain and was commanded by God to consume a mixture of grain and meat, known as Al-Hareys, as a remedy. In Shia scholarly tradition, this hadith is often cited to establish the prophetic precedent for using nutritious, easily digestible foods for therapeutic purposes, highlighting the holistic approach to health in the Ahl al-Bayt. The specific mention of 'Hareysa' (mashed wheat with meat or fat) underscores the importance of combining carbohydrates and proteins for recovery, a practice still recommended in traditional Islamic medicine.

en.hubeali: (It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullahasws having said that Rasool-Allahsaww complained to hissaww Lordazwj Mighty and Majestic of the back pain, so Heazwj Commanded him with the eating of the grains with the meat, meaning Al-Hareys’.
en.sarwar: 3. In another Hadith in a marfu‘ manner the following is narrated: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, Alayhi al-Salam,

has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, complained before Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, against back pain and He commanded him to eat grains with meat, that is, al-Harisah.”’
